label: PF Backlog 528
title: C3: Defect/RCCA - generated onboarding template claims 'SOC 2 Type II certified' (false compliance claim)
body:
## Acceptance criteria
customer_onboarding (and any template) makes compliance/security claims POLICY-DRIVEN: only assert what is
actually held (config-driven); never a hardcoded 'SOC 2 certified'/'we never share'. Guard + test.

## Out of scope
Acquiring certs.
